summary: Backend-only testing of GEX Tracker & Options Heatmap endpoints (POST /api/ingest/gex, GET /api/gex, GET /api/gex/{symbol}) plus regression on /api/config and core auth. All 13 pytest cases passed on the public preview URL. Ingest-key auth (X-Ingest-Key), symbol whitelist (SPY/SPX/XSP), upsert behavior, premium gating (402 for free), 401 for unauthenticated, 404 for unknown symbols, and Mongo _id exclusion are all working as specified. No frontend tested (per request).
critical_code_review_comments: GEX read endpoints correctly gate on TIER_LEVEL >= 2 (premium) and return 402 for free/pro.
_clean_gex strips Mongo _id before returning; verified no _id leak in responses.
Ingest uses update_one with upsert=True keyed by symbol, ensuring only latest snapshot is stored per symbol.
GEX_INGEST_KEY comparison guards against empty key (returns 401 if env is unset).

GET /api/gex/{symbol} does not validate symbol against GEX_SYMBOLS whitelist - any unknown symbol returns 404 due to no data, which matches requirement but a client could probe symbol space. Low severity.
seed_data_creation: Test SPY snapshot upserted via /api/ingest/gex with strikes; one TEST_ prefixed free user registered for gating tests. No cleanup needed (upserts overwrite existing SPY seed, TEST_ user is isolated).
context_for_next_testing_agent: GEX endpoints fully working. Reusable test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gex.py. GEX_INGEST_KEY is in backend/.env; SPY/SPX/XSP snapshots seeded (SPY was overwritten by test payload with net_gex=2222222222 - main agent may want to re-seed if pretty demo values are needed).
